name: Littlestone Dimension of the Odd-Torsion Dual Class
proof: The established VC value two is a lower bound. In any putative depth-three complete mistake tree, the positive branch at the root would need at least four distinct concepts to realize a depth-two subtree. Every coordinate has only three positive concepts. Thus depth three is impossible and Littlestone dimension is two.
references: Direct complete-tree leaf count and the explicit shattered pair.
